# Tailspin Toys Crowd Funding Development Guidelines

This project's canonical AI agent instructions have moved to [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root, following the [agents.md](https://agents.md/) convention shared across coding agents (GitHub Copilot, Codex, Claude, etc.).

Please read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) before contributing. It covers project overview, code standards, testing requirements, npm scripts, repository structure, and links to the path-scoped files in `.github/instructions/`.

This file is kept only so tools that specifically look for `.github/copilot-instructions.md` still pick up guidance; do not duplicate content here — update `AGENTS.md` instead.
